Image 2 is ONLY hand-grip anatomy / wrist-to-handle continuity reference. Never copy its adult proportions, armor, sword, cape, rendering or crossed weapon axis.

He holds his longsword in anatomical RIGHT hand (SCREEN LEFT) and his SHORT angular dagger in anatomical LEFT hand (SCREEN RIGHT), BOTH naturally LOWERED downward alongside the body. Blade tips point toward the ground slightly away from the feet. Weapons are not raised, not crossed in front of chest or legs, no fighting crouch, no action, no walking. Gaze forward with the original composed determined youthful male impression.

Anatomical RIGHT shoulder SCREEN LEFT has crescent emblem and layered pauldron; RIGHT shin SCREEN LEFT has silver plate greave. Anatomical LEFT shin/boot SCREEN RIGHT is blue wrapped cloth with metal protectors. No new insignia, no long cape, no new weapons.
PROPORTIONS: retain the head-to-chest, skull/face, torso-to-limb and hand/boot proportions of image1, do not normalize to a generic chibi or long adult master. Compact SD bone proportions. Do not round it into the soft shaded variant4, do not paint subtle textured shading over the flat angular cells.
